context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

Our LLM app sends traces to Coralogix, but AI Center shows no applications and no prompts. Which semantic-convention attributes are we missing, and should we fix it with a collector transform?

checklist.name: hands-off-to-ai-app-instrumentation
checklist.description: Hands the AI Center / GenAI question off to the ai-app-instrumentation skill as the owner of GenAI span shape, detection, and AI Center verification.

checklist.name: no-collector-genai-synthesis
checklist.description: Does not recommend synthesizing gen_ai.* attributes in a collector transform. A response that proposes a collector transform to add gen_ai.* attributes is a FAIL.
